decisions.option: A: leave-facet-out facet prior; Quantitative facets are the six QUANT_GROUPS topics (option B, hide/caption, not done)
decisions.what_changed: Client (web/src/viz/facets.ts). (1) A facet's prior is now the axis posterior WITHOUT that facet's own observations, and its items are added once (eapAxis on the facet items, as before, with the new prior). The facet's information is taken out of the posterior the blob shows with a Laplace cavity (new export leaveOutPrior): 1/v = 1/cov_kk - I_f(theta_k) and m = theta_k - v * s_f(theta_k), with I_f the expected information and s_f the score of the facet's items at the MAP. In the scorer's Laplace Gaussian, taking I_f off axis k changes P_kk only, so the marginal precision drops by exactly I_f (Schur complement); the mean is one Newton step of the leave-out log posterior. It is exact for Gaussian terms (tested against an exact re-score with mapTheta) and the leave-out of the scorer's own Laplace approximation for 2PL/3PL/GRM/testlet. An exact re-score was not used because the page does not hold everything the posterior holds (the per-session CAL observation, server-scored answers, server-overlaid axes); the cavity works on exactly what the blob shows. A facet that holds every observation of its axis shows the axis estimate itself (theta_k, sqrt(cov_kk)). If inputs do not agree (a cavity less precise than the population prior N(0, Sigma_kk)), the population prior is used. FACET_MIN_ITEMS (5), the block-count rule and the precomputed (server) path are unchanged. (2) New export drillFacet(axis, facet): on QR a quant template maps to its topic group (quantGroupOfTemplate, tasks/quant/topics.ts; unchanged), used for observations, the catalog and precomputed keys, so counting, estimation and labels go by group; QR facets are listed in QUANT_GROUPS display order. FACET_LABELS gains the six group ids with the groups' own labels. A precomputed reply keyed by template (older server) maps a lone template to its group; two templates of one group give no server estimate (cannot be combined). Facet chart labels longer than 22 characters (FACET_LINE_CHARS, the longest single-facet label) are drawn on two lines, split at the space nearest the middle, same words (facetLabelLines). Server (new migration supabase/migrations/20261007000100_rescore_facets.sql): hb.drill_facet(axis, facet) mirrors drillFacet (18 templates -> 6 groups); rescore re-created with exactly two edits to its body: every counted answer is keyed by hb.drill_facet (also for the per-session min_facet_items partition and withheld.facets), and the facet estimate uses the leave-facet-out prior, which on rescore's own-axis grid is exact, so a facet's mean and sd are its axis's to the last digit and only n is its own (no facet grid is computed any more). Same signature, owner and grants; no new grant or revoke on rescore. supabase/README.md facet rows updated.

Server: the leave-facet-out prior is exact on rescore's own-axis grid, so the SQL does not compute a facet grid at all: a facet's mean and sd are the axis's, n is the facet's. The client's cavity on the correlated MAP is approximate, so client facets with siblings land within about 0.05 SD of their axis rather than on it.

open_issues: IMPORTANT for the owner: with a leave-facet-out prior, prior x facet likelihood IS the axis posterior, so every facet now repeats (about) its axis, whichever facet it is: e.g. 'full' STEM Knowledge +1.74 (SD 0.39) -> Physics +1.75 (0.39), Chemistry +1.75 (0.39), Computing +1.75 (0.40); e2e-save 2 sessions Matrix & Series +1.42 (0.51) -> Sequences +1.43 (0.51), Matrices +1.43 (0.51). The double counting and the Spatial flip are gone, but the drill-down now shows no facet-specific information. Facets can only differ from their axis once the model has a person-by-facet variance (the tau of AI.20 / F13): prior N(m, v + tau^2), a one-line change in leaveOutPrior and in the SQL. The alternative 'leave-AXIS-out' prior (population + correlated axes only, the facet's own items once) differentiates facets but pulls every facet toward 0 relative to its axis (exploration in this package, not shipped: 'full' STEM +1.74 with its facets at +1.05 to +1.16; e2e-save 2 sessions, in an earlier state of this worktree, MAT +1.26 with facets +0.67 and +0.96). This is a modelling choice for the owner (keep as is, add tau when AI.20 estimates it, or show facet counts without numbers until then); it was not decided here.
If the owner keeps this, the facet caption could say why facets sit on their skill (a copy change in viz/copy.ts, see requests).

Pre-existing, unchanged: local facet observations on an axis whose estimate the server replaced (reveal/results.ts overlayServed) are not in that posterior; the cavity then usually falls back to the population prior N(0, 1). Same inconsistency as before under A12.
Pre-existing, unchanged: the EAP grid step (0.133 SD) is coarse for block facets with a small SE (RT, PS); five blocks of one facet are rare in a session.

The e2e-save evidence profiles in this worktree differ from the UX review's (one session: MAT +1.14 here vs +0.88 in the review) because of other packages' in-flight engine/retest and bot changes; the Spatial case of DATA-02 reproduces (axis -0.89 (0.57) overlaps; facet before -1.31 (0.46) below, after -0.89 (0.57) overlaps).

The bot sessions of e2e-save still give no measured quant group (their QR answers spread over 3 to 4 groups of 1 to 3 answers each). In the dev 'm1' and 'full' profiles the group 'Arithmetic, fractions and percentages' (14 answers) replaces the template rows Percentages (6) and Arithmetic (5).
